findings.message: @PathVariable String orderId on CancelOrderAPI.cancel takes an id as a raw String; take the bounded context's semantic id type (e.g. OrderId) at the edge (rules/slice-design.md § The command and the view *are* the contract)
findings.hint: two parts: type the parameter, then for a `CharSequenceType` / `SingleValueType` id always make sure exactly one configurer matching the web stack is `@Import`ed — `EssentialsWebMvcConfigurer` for spring-webmvc, `EssentialsWebFluxConfigurer` for spring-webflux (stack contract S4, ESS-031). It is required for an id with no `String` route (HTTP 500 without it) and the rule even where Spring's own conversion would bind one; stack-lint reports either case (`s4-typed-edge-unregistered` / `s4-typed-edge-convention`)
